Phase 6 (decision 0008) note: every student who calls the interest test now answers all 20 questions -- amir/mei_ling/priya/aisyah/daniel's originally-partial pick lists are padded with 'None of the above' for every question they didn't already answer, so their interest/love scores are unchanged (None of the above contributes 0 picks to any area) while the interest test is genuinely complete, satisfying the new completeness gate. Rahman still answers none (call_interest_answers: false), so he stays incomplete, unchanged from before.
